subject: Rate limits & overage pricing — follow-up and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@skyrocket.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: rate limits / overage discussion (post-call)

Thanks Alex — great chat earlier. To summarize and confirm next steps from our discovery: 

- Steady-state expected usage: ~20M tokens/day (inference + prompts).
- Burst pattern: 10–15 minute spikes up to ~80M tokens/day equivalent (short spike windows tied to marketing drops).
- Target procurement budget range: $30k–$50k/month.
- Pricing target: your finance team indicated a target of roughly $600–$850 per 1M tokens (all-in for prompt+completion) — can you confirm a firm target or range?

Immediate asks from our side so we can build a proposal:
1) Can you share a sample CSV of hourly token volumes for the last 30 days (attachment stub welcomed).
2) Confirm acceptable burst window size (minutes) and tolerated overage multiplier before pre-approval (e.g., 2x burst for <=15 minutes).
3) Any procurement constraints (PO terms, net days, or required contract language) we should factor into proposal?

I've attached a short example usage CSV (Skyrocket_usage_sample.csv) that shows the columns we'd need. Rafael will scope pricing options (hosted & dedicated paths) and an initial overage policy draft.

Next step: Rafael to send a provisional pricing sheet, then we set up a quick procurement call with your team. Would Sept 22 at 10am PT work for a 30-min sync?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
Phone: (415) 555-0189

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@skyrocket.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@skyrocket.ai>
Date: 2026-09-18T16:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: rate limits / overage discussion (post-call)

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. Quick answers below and I've attached a sanitized hourly export.

- Confirmed steady-state: ~20M tokens/day (avg over last 30 days).
- Bursts: typically 8–20 minutes, historically pushing up to ~75–90M tokens within those short windows. Happens ~4–6 times/month tied to product announcements.
- Budget: stakeholder alignment around $30k–$50k/mo; procurement wants a clear quote showing unit economics.
- Target $/1M tokens: the product team would like to see pricing modeled in the $650–$800 per 1M tokens range to evaluate feasibility. If Redwood can show predictable overage limits and a burst accommodation policy, that helps.

Procurement note: we need any proposed overage policy to include automatic notification to our SREs + a 24-hour grace window before billing any sustained overage above pre-approved burst caps.

I've attached "Skyrocket_usage_sample.csv" (sanitized). Looking forward to Rafael's pricing options.

--
Alex
Head of Platform | Skyrocket AI
alex.johnson@skyrocket.ai
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@skyrocket.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: rate limits / overage discussion (post-call)

Alex — appreciated the data. We reviewed the CSV and sketched two pricing paths: Hosted (usage-based) and Dedicated (committed capacity). High-level notes in attached provisional-pricing-SKY-472.pdf. Key points: 

- Recommended baseline quota: 25M tokens/day (covers steady-state + small buffer).
- Burst accommodation: automatic short-term burst allowance up to 3x baseline for windows <= 15 minutes. Bursts beyond that will be throttled to preserve platform stability.
- Overage billing: if usage exceeds quota and burst allowance, overage will be billed at 1.5x the standard per-1M rate for the invoiced month. For customers on annual committed contracts, we can offer lower overage multipliers (1.2x) and pre-approved temporary quota increases.
- Notification & grace: we can implement: (a) real-time webhook + email to your SREs; (b) 24-hour grace window before invoicing sustained >baseline overages; (c) instant throttling option if requested.
- Pre-approval workflow: a) submit request via console or signed email, b) our ops team approves within 4 business hours for emergency increases up to 5x baseline for up to 2 hours, c) for longer increases we require a change request and may convert to committed capacity.

Pricing quick example (hosted):
- Standard rate: $700 per 1M tokens.
- If overage: $1,050 per 1M tokens (1.5x) for amounts beyond approved allowance.
- For an initial 3-month pilot we can put a cap on monthly spend with a 10% buffer for approved bursts.

I'll attach the PDF (provisional-pricing-SKY-472.pdf) with a few modeled scenarios (20M steady / 4 bursts @80M). Marissa — recommend we present the hosted model plus a committed quote if they want a lower unit cost.

Rafael
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
From: Procurement <procurement@skyrocket.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: rate limits / overage discussion (post-call)

Rafael / Marissa — procurement here. A few clarifying items before we can proceed to a formal quote: 

1) We require a maximum allowed burst RPS (requests per second) threshold for each environment (prod/staging). Can you confirm typical RPS to tokens mapping or propose RPS limits equivalent to the 3x burst policy? For example, our engineering wants a hard cap of 200 RPS for production unless pre-approved.
2) Please include a DocuSign-ready quote and the standard MA/T&C showing billing terms (Net30 preferred).
3) Confirmation of the 24-hour grace window and webhook notification cadence.

If those are acceptable we can route for an internal PO and DocuSign signature. Also include a contact for technical onboarding and a rough timeline for quota increase approvals for urgent bursts.

Thanks — Procurement Team
procurement@skyrocket.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Procurement <procurement@skyrocket.ai>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@skyrocket.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: rate limits / overage discussion (post-call)

Thanks — got it. Quick confirmations and next steps: 

- RPS mapping: we'll convert your usage CSV into a recommended RPS cap per environment. As a starting point, our ops team recommends a soft limit of 200 RPS for prod to match the 3x burst allowance you asked about; we can make it a hard cap if you prefer. We'll provide the exact mapping in the formal quote.
- DocuSign & MA/T&C: Rafael attaching a DocuSign-ready quote and a draft MA/T&C (Draft-MA-T&C-Redwood.docx). We'll include Net30 billing terms by default; note enterprise procurement clauses may require edits.
- Grace & notifications: confirmed — real-time webhook + email to your SREs, 24-hour grace before billing sustained overages, and a 4-business-hour approval SLA for emergency quota increases up to 5x baseline for short windows.
- Technical onboarding contact: Camila Reyes (camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com) — she will lead the integration and runbook for handling burst events.

Next step: Rafael will send the formal quote + DocuSign link today. Camila will reach out to Alex's SRE to schedule a 45-min onboarding call next week.

Looking forward — Marissa
